dogecoin.text: #Dogecoin has to be one of the greatest studies in crowd psychology ever. Now that @elonmusk lost his price influence, people are stuck HODLing in the hopes it reaches $1. But if that’s everyone’s goal, what makes you think every holder won’t dump at the same time?
This is true on so many levels. Sucks for those #dogecoin holders… the unfortunate truth (no, I’m not one of them)
I’m all about crypto and hope the best for any project…. But I can’t help but find amusing that #dogecoin is looking like a stable coin lol.
@CoinMarketCap Ummmm Dogecoin… but I’m much better now lol
